data.body: Completion-audit remediation (2026-08-15). The analysis is complete, but the prior description incorrectly called local files under reports/ committed; /reports/ is intentionally gitignored. Durable evidence is the ticket trail plus the published artifact. ORDINAL_MIGRATION_PLAN_DURABLE_COPY: Phase 0 removes unused plan-review base-five emissions, records decision margin, and records code-review verification blocks without changing decisions. Phase 1 converts undecomposed and dod_uncertifiable to closed kind sets behind a plan-v5 bump. Phase 2 replaces the remaining plan-review ordinal ladders with narrow binary subquestions and deterministic level derivation behind plan-v6; validation replays boundary findings and keeps an ordinal axis if zero-lost-block and control over-block gates fail. Phase 3 addresses code-review separately using its recovered 3,230-finding verification corpus. Operator approval remains required before executing any migration; this ticket only completed the analysis and plan. Full report artifact: https://claude.ai/code/artifact/725e8b52-688d-49ed-a286-4571bedce34d
